active_work_item.title: Upload and analysis safety boundaries
active_work_item.depends_on: CP7-01 independently QA-passed at e2dd3df4e14b254a1bca7965c26a3cc17464e85f and merged via PR #18 at 1a2d416199ed90125f77f875464a2ad8656a406c
active_work_item.reason: First bounded CP8 slice: harden the existing 2-3 quote ingestion/analysis boundary without provider, payment, deployment, or production-storage changes. Enforce deterministic input count/type/size/text limits at the existing application boundary; reject malformed/unsupported/oversized inputs before analysis; ensure parser/analysis failures produce safe recoverable user states without leaking raw stack traces, secrets, provider internals, or fabricated report content; preserve extraction uncertainty/source evidence and existing golden journey. Add deterministic tests for boundary rejection, malformed content, recoverable failure, and no-analysis-on-invalid-input. Inspect existing limits/contracts before choosing values and document any new constants. Keep scope mobile-first and narrow. Exact PR-head install/lint/typecheck/tests/evals/build required before Independent QA. No paid/live eval, preview mutation, production deployment/storage/payment/provider mutation, secrets, or other YELLOW/RED action authorized.

commercial_milestone: A stranger can upload 2-3 quotes, receive a useful preview, unlock a complete report, and receive grounded analysis without fabricated findings
